title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to edit containers for an allowed label could forge the…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with permission to edit containers for an allowed label can forge the author attribution of container pins and access user details beyond their authorization. This occurs because the Container Pin REST API does not properly restrict caller-provided author fields, allowing reassignment of pin authors and unauthorized querying of user-related data.
